suppress.notes: JAI core (javax.media.jai). Shipped: lg3d-core `run` + releaseBundle allow-list, used by the incubator's Image Studio, whose operators registry is JAI-specific. Sun/Oracle JAI is end-of-life; no fixed version exists and the reference implementation is not redistributable under a compatible licence.
JAI codecs (javax.media.jai.codec). Shipped alongside jai_core.jar for the same Image Studio dependency; same end-of-life position -- no maintained replacement.

Java Media Framework (javax.media). Shipped: Algea3D and the ported jmf23D app are built on the JMF controller API. JMF was discontinued by Sun in 2005; there is no successor artefact to upgrade to (the fobs4jmf/jl1.0 jars below are its codecs), so "upgrade" is not an available answer for this binary.
FOBs4JMF -- a streaming Ogg Vorbis demuxer for JMF. Shipped as a JMF codec for Algea3D. Upstream project is dormant since the 2000s; no fixed release exists.

JLayer 1.0 -- MP3 decoding for JMF. Shipped as a JMF codec. The 1.0 branch is long superseded by JLayer 1.0.1 in name only upstream (different licence, not a drop-in for the JMF plug-in API), so the vendored jar cannot be bumped in place.

Apache Commons CLI 1.0. Shipped because Algea3D's main() parses its arguments with the 1.0 API (OptionConstructor-style), which later 1.x releases removed. The class is small and its input is argv, so the 1.0 CVE surface (no deserialisation, no network parsing) is bounded -- but the exclusion carries an expiry, not an exemption: replacing the call sites with the current commons-cli is the real fix.
JavaNLP (Natural Language Processing library). Shipped for the incubator's WordNet/semantic apps. Unmaintained binary vendored in-tree since 2006; no upstream release to upgrade to.

NanoXML Lite 2.2.3. Shipped: nanoxml is the XML reader some 2006-era apps use directly. Small non-security-focused parser, but the parse-untrusted-XML findings against it are never going to be patched upstream, so the entry is time-boxed and the real answer is moving those call sites to the JDK parser.

Prefuse visualisation toolkit. Shipped for the incubator's graph/telephone apps. Dormant since the Google Code era; the source archive is not rebuilt upstream, so there is no fixed version to move to.

jbusinessday -- the business-day/holiday calendar Agenda 3D compiles against (declared as a file dependency in lg3d-core and lg3d-incubator, and copied into releaseBundle's lib/). A SNAPSHOT of an unmaintained project vendored in libs/; no release artefact exists to upgrade to, so the entry expires rather than becoming permanent -- at which point either the jar is gone or a person re-signs the risk for another quarter.

IconManager 1.6.0 -- a shaded fat jar (it embeds slf4j-simple and other third-party classes) used for icon resolution and the tray gauge. Compile-only in lg3d-core/lg3d-apps but its repackaged output (slimIconManagerJar) is on the run classpath, so it ships. Being a fat jar, its embedded dependencies are the findings; they cannot be bumped without rebuilding the upstream artefact, which is why this entry carries an expiry.

JavaBeans Activation Framework (javax.activation), 2006-era. Compile-time only, for the incubator's Mail/blackgoat apps; superseded by jakarta/angular activation which the shipped Mail app already uses, so the legacy jar stays off the run classpath.
Apache Axis 1.x -- end-of-life since 2006, retired by the ASF. Compile-time only for the incubator's web-service apps; the upgrade path (Axis2/JAX-WS) is a rewrite of those apps, not a version bump.
Apache Commons Discovery 0.2 -- an Axis 1 helper, long unmaintained. Compile-time only, never on the run classpath.

Apache Commons Logging 1.0.4 -- superseded by the current 1.3.x released through Maven Central, but here only as an Axis 1 compile-time companion; the shipping desktop does not load it (JUL is the desktop's own logging path).

JAX-RPC API stubs bundled with Axis 1. Compile-time only; the javax.xml.rpc API is part of the removed Java EE modules in JDK 11+, which is precisely why the apps that need it are incubator-only and excluded from the shipped classpath.

Apache Log4j 1.2.8 (under ext/axis/), carried only so the 2006-era Axis apps compile. Log4j 1.x is end-of-life (Log4Shell-adjacent findings in 1.x are never going to be patched). Compile-time only -- the shipping desktop uses JUL, and the incubator's log4j.jar twin below is excluded on the same terms.
SAAJ (javax.xml.soap) stubs bundled with Axis 1. Compile-time only; Java EE module removed from the JDK, hence not on the desktop classpath.
WSDL4J 1.5.1 -- Axis 1's WSDL reader, unmaintained. Compile-time only.

Xerces-Impl (ancient Apache Xerces-J) bundled with Axis 1 -- the single most dangerous jar in ext/, because it registers itself as the JAXP parser and would override the platform XML implementation. lg3d-core/build.gradle and the incubator's own test task both exclude it from any runtime/test classpath for exactly that reason, so it is a compile-time artefact of the ported Axis apps only. Never shipped; the exclusion is what keeps the CVE report readable.

BouncyCastle bcprov built for JDK 1.4 (unsigned "jdk14" line). Compile-time only, for the incubator's crypto-using demos. Current bcprov releases exist on Maven Central for the shipped code paths; this jar stays because a 2006 app calls the removed 1.4 provider API surface.

Apache Commons IO 1.0 -- predates IOUtils.byteArray(int), which is why lg3d-incubator/build.gradle drops it from the test classpath so POI's transitive commons-io 2.18.0 wins. Compile-time only for fm3d's FileUtils; never shipped.

JAIMlib -- the AIM TOC client library the wilkoaim3d incubator app compiles against. AOL discontinued the AIM TOC service in Dec 2017, so the app can never log in; the jar is kept only so the source still compiles. Compile-time only, never on the run classpath, and there is no upstream fix coming.
JPedal STD (Java PDF renderer), a 2006 commercial evaluation build. Compile-time only for the incubator's PDF viewer. No vendor update exists for this artefact.
JXTA -- the Sun P2P platform the incubator's jxta chat app compiles against. Project archived; the 2.x line has unpatched findings and no maintainer. Compile time only, never shipped.

JavaMail (javax.mail), kept only for the incubator's blackgoat mail app. The shipped Mail app uses angus-mail/jakarta.mail instead -- lg3d-incubator/build.gradle excludes this jar from the test classpath because its old com/sun/mail/handlers/text_plain provider collides with angus-mail's jakarta one.
SVG Salamander -- the incubator SVG viewer's renderer. Unmaintained since the Google Code era; compile-time only, not on the run classpath.
